catalogue.title: Duplicate Payment Detection
catalogue.description: Identical amount billed twice by the same vendor within 10 days.

catalogue.title: Split Invoice / Threshold Circumvention
catalogue.description: Three or more sub-threshold invoices in a 5-day window that together exceed the approval limit.

catalogue.title: Segregation of Duties Breach
catalogue.description: The same user both entered and approved the payment.

catalogue.title: Approval Authority Exceeded
catalogue.description: Payment released by an approver whose delegated limit is below the invoice value.

catalogue.title: Out-of-Hours Posting
catalogue.description: Material payment posted outside 08:00-20:00 on a working day.

catalogue.title: Round-Amount Anomaly
catalogue.description: Material invoice booked at an exact multiple of 10,000 with no tax or rounding residue.

catalogue.title: Benford's Law Digit Anomaly
catalogue.description: Vendor invoice values whose leading-digit distribution fails a chi-square fit against Benford's Law.

catalogue.title: Payment After Bank-Detail Change
catalogue.description: Material payment released within 14 days of a change to the vendor bank account.

catalogue.title: Dormant Vendor Reactivation
catalogue.description: Material payment to a vendor that had been inactive for more than 180 days.

catalogue.title: Vendor Baseline Outlier
catalogue.description: Payment more than three standard deviations above the vendor's own historical mean.
